result_text:
The per-rep purchase-order count now leaves out cancelled purchase orders. I didn't add a test for your Anna/Bob example.

The change is in `DataStore.findPurchaseOrderCountPerSalesRep` (`src/main/java/com/acme/backoffice/DataStore.java`). I added `po.status <> 'CANCELLED'` to the count subquery, which matches how the quarterly and weekday purchase-order queries do it. Reps with no purchase orders are still listed with 0, and the ordering is unchanged. I also added a line to the method's Javadoc saying cancelled orders are excluded.

I ran the tests matching `*SalesRep*` plus `DemoScenarioTest`, and they passed (exit code 0).
